scenarios.title: silence when nothing changed, restraint about a one-off link
scenarios.description: A routine watches state.txt. Two runs with no change must stay quiet. A one-off article link from small talk must not become a stored reference, and the unrelated turn must not spawn an extra routine.

actions.text: 用 UpdateRoutine 创建一个例行任务：action create，标题 State Watch，排程 @every 1m，delivery held，urgent true，urgent_reason eval-window。每次要做的事：读取工作区 state.txt（必须用 read 工具，不要用 bash）。如果内容恰好是 READY，最终回复只写 [quiet]；否则最终回复写 CHANGED_V2 后接一个空格和文件内容。
